verification_instruction: 이미지나 랜더링 피드백에 필요한건 검사는하되, 과도한 테스트는 하지말것

implementation.hierarchy: pelvis-waist-chest-neck-head, paired shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand and hip-knee-ankle-toe chains
implementation.coordinate_system: Y up, X locomotion, Z depth, forward +X, RH view with 0..1 clip depth
implementation.mesh_source: original procedural spheres, ellipsoids, cylinders and boxes
implementation.camera: orthographic, default yaw 25 degrees and pitch 12 degrees
implementation.pose_demo: sine-driven joint rotations, lowest toe height adjustment, no support-foot locking
implementation.screenshot: GPU render target readback to SDL_SavePNG, same target blitted to native window

findings: Neutral mannequin and overlaid bones share the joint positions
Spine and left/right arm and leg chains are visible with distinct colors
Solid meshes follow the phase 1.0 walking pose with 3D occlusion and basic lighting

not_implemented: Adopted clone_01 appearance, textures, hair, cape and clothing
M16, shoulder contact, firing, reload, kneeling
Production locomotion, contact IK and physics
